modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
implement safe working practices for dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
conduct regular checks of the machines with support of the maintenance team to identify potential hazards
ensure that all the tools/equipment/fasteners/spare parts are arranged as per specifications/utility into proper trays, cabinets, lockers as mentioned in the 5S guidelines/work instructions
organise safety drills or training sessions to create awareness amongst others on the identified risks and safety practices
fill daily check sheet to report improvements done and risks identified
ensure that relevant safety boards/signs are placed on the shop floor for the safety of self and others
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
ensure team is aware about hygiene and sanitation regulations and following them on the shop floor
ensure availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at the workplace
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques and support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste
ensure malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment are resolved effectively
prepare and analyze material and energy audit reports to decipher excessive consumption of material and water
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized

modules.module_title: Prepare for building an ADAS system

pcs.pc_description: obtain design document and inputs from the OEM/customer for building an ADAS system
interpret design document, ADAS design standards and protocols to identify system requirements and testing parameters which need to be measured during the testing procedure

identify and select appropriate development tools, programming language (i.e. java, python), development platform, driver interface, telematics system, controllers, sensors and actuators etc. as per the project requirements
prepare plan and costing for developing the ADAS system as per the requirements
install the sensors, actuators etc. in a dummy vehicle for data collection purpose
set-up function-based obstructions on test track
perform test vehicle ‘pre-test’ conditioning
conduct the test drives of the vehicle and collate the data of sensors, actuators etc. on required testing parameters for the analysis purpose
drive and simulate all the functions of ADAS and failure points
perform documentation for test set-up and validation
prepare the data, which may include trimming, decoding, data enrichment (labeling or ground truth generation), processing and adding metadata such as weather and traffic conditions
analyse the results of testing and prepare process design to implement required ADAS standards and protocols in the ADAS system
identify components of an ADAS system for building the ADAS architecture on the basis of requirement
develop and build algorithms for ADAS system operation as per the requirement
build code and configure software of micro- controllers, its components and their oriented design using embedded C, C++ and MATLAB
write clean and scalable codes
perform data automation for data outputs by using python, R, java, etc
create data visualizations by using Power BI, Python
validate codes of all the components of architecture to ensure required output
analyse and validate behavior of the system
prepare a learning and development plan considering safety standards and protocol

modules.module_title: Prepare for implementing and testing of ADAS system

pcs.pc_description: design steps to go from ADAS system level configuration
select system configuration input and customize it as per the requirement
integrate all sensors, actuators, controllers and allied systems with the vehicle
build test suites with various test use cases, as well as required closed-loop simulation and open-loop re-simulation (replay) validation jobs to verify ADAS models
plan to use proper testing methodologies to check the system functioning as per specifications

modules.module_title: Perform implementation and testing of ADAS system

pcs.pc_description: perform a severity wise assessment of vehicle for safety worthiness relevant to ADAS verification as prescribed in NHTSA
develop and execute functional test procedures
test the performance of the system against product specifications and regulatory requirements
perform product reliability and validation testing
perform unit testing frameworks
perform tracking of quality assurance matrix
manage multiple release streams within source code management tool
perform system testing of ADAS features in SiL, HiL, LABCAR and Vehicle
perform unit testing, functional and integration testing and system testing

modules.module_title: Perform validation and execution of ADAS system

pcs.pc_description: review codes and UTCs to identify errors, if any
check inputs to identify design corrections
correct the code and submit the corrected code to the concerned person for approval
perform development and integration with third party software
